description: This file implements a custom formatter for the 'spew' package, providing detailed and recursive string representations of data structures, including handling of pointers, interfaces, and various data types. It defines the 'formatState' class and associated methods for formatting values, as well as the 'NewFormatter' function to create instances of the custom formatter.

classes.name: formatState
classes.description: A class that implements the 'fmt.Formatter' interface, encapsulating the state needed to format a value, including the value itself, formatting flags, depth, pointer tracking, and configuration.

methods.name: buildDefaultFormat
methods.description: Recreates the default format string without width or precision, used for unrecognized types.

methods.name: constructOrigFormat
methods.description: Recreates the original format string including width, precision, and verb for passing to fmt.Sprintf.

methods.name: unpackValue
methods.description: Unpacks interface values to their underlying value, handling nil interfaces.

methods.name: formatPtr
methods.description: Handles formatting of pointer values, including indirection, type display, and cycle detection.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main recursive function that formats reflect.Values based on their kind, handling various data types and circular references.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Implements the 'fmt.Formatter' interface, directing formatting based on the verb and value.

methods.name: NewFormatter
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the custom formatter for a given value.
